7890.title: Viewport height override survives silent geometry recovery
7890.rootCauseOneLine: A resize after blur reapplies a short shell height; the one-shot viewport updater never resamples a later silent recovery.

prReviews.topFinding: Bounded iOS reconciliation targets the verified event-ordering gap; the linked branch was not executed and native timing remains unverified.

7890.proposedFix: Bound iOS viewport resampling after focus and viewport transitions, reconcile late geometry, cancel sampling on unmount, and preserve non-iOS pan behavior.
7890.caveats: The hook race was reproduced twice on trusted main. Live visual and native iOS behavior remain unverified: Browser Automation could not start Chrome because host shared libraries are absent. No screenshot was fabricated. An existing open PR links to the issue, so no duplicate fix was opened.
